ائتمنت (form VIII)
# اِئْتَمَنْتُ (iʔtamantu) /iʔ.ta.man.tu/: first-person singular past active of اِئْتَمَنَ (iʔtamana)
# اِئْتَمَنْتَ (iʔtamanta) /iʔ.ta.man.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of اِئْتَمَنَ (iʔtamana)
# اِئْتَمَنْتِ (iʔtamanti) /iʔ.ta.man.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of اِئْتَمَنَ (iʔtamana)
# اِئْتَمَنَتْ (iʔtamanat) /iʔ.ta.ma.nat/: third-perso
